description: NaNa₂Mg₂Cl₇ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4/mmm space group. The structure consists of two Na clusters inside a Na₂Mg₂Cl₇ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a distorted cuboctahedral geometry to  atoms. In the Na₂Mg₂Cl₇ framework, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five Cl atoms. There is one shorter (2.66 Å) and four longer (3.11 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. Mg is bonded to six Cl atoms to form corner-sharing MgCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. There are a spread of Mg-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.50 Å. There are three inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Mg atoms. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Mg atom. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Mg atoms.
